descriptions: Every guide we have written about the blue Staffordshire Bull Terrier in one place: the breed itself, the DNA tests and vaccinations, and how to pick.
Our blue Staffy guides index: what the breed needs, what we test for, and the questions to put to any UK breeder before you part with a deposit here.
A UK breeder's reading list for blue Staffy buyers: the breed guide, the health page and the buying guide, plus how to ask us what they do not answer.

brief.goal: Turn an archive stub with no body, no H1 and two linked headings into the index of everything Blue Staffy UK has written down, so a reader who arrives from a search result can see the whole set — one post and three long guides — understand what each one answers, and know who wrote them and how to ask for what is missing.
brief.scope: Seven sections: hero, four takeaway cards, the post list from the `blog` content collection, the three long guides as link-first sentences, one review, a three-row FAQ and the close. One image, a puppy master reused at its original path and alt text, because data/page-map.json records the migrated URL as carrying none.
brief.done: The URL renders a real hub on PageShell: an H1, a card list generated from the `blog` collection, the three long guides linked once each with link-first anchors, one review, three FAQ rows written into data/faq.json in the same commit as the page, a close that states the email address and the hours, and no invented publication schedule, no claim about a guide that does not exist and no second copy of the enquiry form; it passes facts-preserved and link parity with nothing missing that `dropped` does not explain.
out_of_scope: rewriting the one post's copy: build 5 owns blog copy, and this task rebuilds the hub and the post's LAYOUT only (plan Task 14)
a publication cadence of any kind — weekly, monthly, 'regularly updated': no file on disk holds a schedule, and inventing one is the easiest false promise a blog index can make

author bylines other than Lisa Bright: data/settings.json holds breeder_name Lisa Bright and the collection entry's `author` is the generic 'Blue Staffy UK Team'; Known Issue 12 is about a byline nobody can verify
tags, categories, an archive by month and a search box: the collection holds one entry, and taxonomy over one item is furniture
a newsletter or subscribe block: no file on disk holds a list, and `tuple.newsletter` is empty on this record
an enquiry form: the contact page carries the one form the form audit measures, and this page links to it
the puppy grid and the prices: a reading index is not a listing, and /blue-staffy-pup-sale-uk/ and /buy-blue-staffy-puppies-uk/ are the pages that carry them
the site's other index at /blog/: two indexes of one collection linking each other is a loop, and the link is logged in `dropped.links`

strategy.name: the reading list
strategy.why: Of the three hubs scanned, two are bare card grids with no dates and no authors and the third spends two of its eight H2s on its own insurance and cost calculator; none of them says why one guide rather than another. Saying what each page answers is both the reader's question and the whole gap.
